ai_executive_summary: We are purging all lingering 'Deep Ocean' high-concept distractions to finalize our transition to 'Aggressive Relatability.' By focusing on the everyday frustrations our audience experiences, we turn their personal confusion into viral social currency.
self_learning_reflection: Previous attempts to pivot back to 'Deep Ocean' content caused a friction-loss in engagement depth; viewers want to discuss their own lives, not distant abyss mysteries. The 'Systemic Glitch' frame is the highest-performing hook for comment-section retention.
recommended_topics_to_produce: The 'Weather Wall' Lie: Why your app says it's sunny in Kerala but the second you cross the border into Karnataka, the rain shadow ruins your entire trip.
The 6-Second Football Goalkeeper 'Cheat Code': Why every goalie is technically breaking the rules every time they hold the ball and why the referee is literally just letting it slide.
The 'Doorway Amnesia' Glitch: Why your brain deletes your intention the second you walk into a new room—you aren't forgetful, you're just running on outdated hardware.
infinite_loop_directive: End every video by asking: 'Does this happen to you every day, or is your brain just better optimized than mine?'—forcing the viewer to re-watch to confirm their own experience.
debate_bait_strategy: Directly pit two groups against each other (e.g., iPhone users vs Android users, or Kerala travelers vs Karnataka locals) by claiming one group is 'smarter' for noticing the glitch.
